newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan's Cheng An in T$5.8 bln steel investment.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan's Cheng An in T$5.8 bln steel investment.

text.p: Taiwan's steel maker Cheng An Steel Ltd said on Wednesday it would invest T$5.8 billion to build a cold-rolled galvanised steel production line with annual capacity of 300,000 tonnes.
The production line would be compeleted in early 1998, a Cheng An official told Reuters by telephone.
Cheng An is a subsidiary of Taiwan's second largest steelmaker, Taiwan An Feng Steel Co, which is in the process of merging with Australia's Kingstream Resources NL.
Since June 1996, An Feng has invested T$10 billion in Cheng An, which can produce 300,000 tonnes of hot-rolled galvanised steel and one million tonnes of cold-rolled steel a year. (US$1=T$27.8)
